findings.title: SSH is reachable from the network
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 6.6.1p1 Ubuntu.
findings.remediation: Restrict SSH access to trusted sources and require key-based authentication.

findings.title: Public web service is reachable
findings.evidence: Port 80/tcp is open and identified as Apache httpd 2.4.7 with the title Go ahead and ScanMe!
findings.remediation: Keep the web server patched and review exposed content and headers.

findings.title: Nonstandard ports are open
findings.remediation: Confirm each nonstandard service is expected and document its purpose.

ai_summary.executive: The scan found a public demo host with SSH, Apache HTTP, Nping echo, and one tcpwrapped service exposed. This is a useful baseline internet-facing example with a small number of services and recognizable Nmap demo content.
